name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament says the July 2024 election in Venezuela was not free or fair. It recognises opposition candidate Edmundo González Urrutia as the legitimate, democratically elected president. It asks European Union countries to do the same and to help him take office on 10 January 2025. It condemns the government of Nicolás Maduro for fraud, repression and arrests, and calls for sanctions and for the release of political prisoners. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament recognises González as Venezuela's elected president; European Union countries are urged to follow.
- It asks for sanctions on Maduro and his circle, and for the release of political prisoners.
- It calls for pressure so the elected president can take office on 10 January 2025.
